items.item: Glue: embedding smoke runs (4, one failed)
EC2 m7i-flex.large, 5.84 instance-hours at $0.09576/h (Price List rate x launch-to-stop hours; not from the bill)
EBS gp3 60 GB while running (5.84 h; billing continues at about $4.80/month while stopped)

reconciliation: Glue lines are `dpu_seconds / 3600 x $0.44` from `get_job_run` (job-metrics files). Cost Explorer for 2026-11-22 UTC showed 42.59 DPU-hours = $18.74 before credits against the job-metrics sum of 41.44 + 1.13 (the export runs) = 42.57; the EC2, EBS and IPv4 lines are estimates from list prices and the instance's launch-to-stop time and are not in Cost Explorer yet (it lags about a day). Account-wide, Cost Explorer on 2026-11-23 (before credits): November usage $31.18 = Glue $30.79 (69.97 DPU-hours x $0.44, M1 and M2 included) + $0.40 other (Cost Explorer $0.08, Athena $0.12, RDS $0.01, S3 $0.19; not separable by milestone); credits remaining $168.82 (`aws freetier get-account-plan-state`), consistent with $200.00 minus $31.18. EC2 does not appear in Cost Explorer yet.
